company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech serving exporters with business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance. Its work spans payments, risk, data and client experience, with a focus on reducing complexity and moving quickly to meet clients’ needs.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues across teams, taking responsibility and learning from mistakes, and working efficiently. Halden Pay promotes career development through career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring. Most offices use a hybrid model, typically with three days in the office, and regular team events help connect colleagues across roughly 40 offices.

Reviews describe a commercially driven culture with friendly colleagues, though experiences with onboarding and training can vary between teams. Culture ratings are around 3.3–3.4 out of 5.

work_context.location_limits: Lisbon, Portugal; 3 days per week in the office. No other location, time-zone, or work-authorisation limits are stated.
culture_signals: The ad emphasizes reusable frameworks and collaboration with data scientists, analytics engineers, and BI colleagues.
Company values: Together (share context openly and help across teams), Ownership (own, fix, and learn from problems), and Pace (reduce unnecessary complexity to move quickly for clients).
Company describes colleagues as friendly and its environment as collaborative, with teamwork and personal development emphasized.
Company says it offers career paths, a yearly learning budget, and mentoring; the ad also mentions a training and certification budget and support for open-source contributions.
Culture reviews describe the culture as commercially driven and say onboarding and training vary considerably between teams.
work_context.notes: The ad specifies this job is hybrid in Lisbon, with 3 office days per week. This is consistent with the company pages, which describe the Lisbon office as hybrid with 3 days in the office and say most offices follow that pattern.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
